label: rem:jet-as-descent
title: Jet prolongation as formal descent of information
html: In the cosimplicial crossed groupoid of cosimplicial crossed groupoid, the coface map \delta^0 \colon \mathfrak{G}_n \to \mathfrak{G}_{n+1} applied to a local section x_i^{(n)} produces the jet-prolonged section x_i^{(n+1)} = J^1(x_i^{(n)}). This is precisely the content of jet prolongation: the jet prolongation carries information from level \mathfrak{G}_n up to \mathfrak{G}_{n+1}, packaged as a coface map. The descent is the map in the opposite direction: the retraction property \sigma^0 \circ \delta^0 = \mathrm{id} shows that the codegeneracy \sigma^0 = \mathfrak{d}_{n+1} \colon \mathfrak{G}_{n+1} \to \mathfrak{G}_n descends the prolonged section back to level n, inverting this map, underpinning the descent involution (descent involution).
